name: unity_gameobject_ops
description: Unity Editor GameObject creation, deletion, transform, and hierarchy operations via run_unity_python. Use when AI needs to: (1) create/delete/duplicate GameObjects, (2) set position/rotation/scale, (3) get or set parent-child relationships, (4) set active state, (5) get current editor selection, (6) rename GameObjects, (7) move objects in hierarchy. NOT for: adding/removing components (use unity-component-ops), asset operations (use unity-asset-ops).
author: ArtClaw
